def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a single path component with no separators and no parent reference."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../secret.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name:
        return False
    return True

def note_text(name: str) -> str | None uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the notes directory, or None when it is missing, unreadable, or not a plain name.

    Opens the directory with `with fs = fs.sub("notes"):` so every read is confined to it.
    Names that fail is_plain_name are rejected before any read.
    """
    pre name.byte_len() >= 0
    if not is_plain_name(name=name):
        return None
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read_text(name) else return
    return text

def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the first name in `names` readable inside the notes directory, or "" when none can be read.

    Names are untrusted; `note_text` confines every read to notes.
    """
    post out.byte_len() >= 0
    for name in names:
        text = note_text(name=name)
        if text is not None:
            return text
    return ""
